notes: New: a “What’s next?” guide. Tap Next at the top of any tab to see where you are and what to do next — add a debt, fill in due dates, enter your monthly plan, choose a payoff order, log a payment, back up. Each step has a button that takes you straight there.
Until those six steps are done, the next one shows at the top of the Dashboard. Hide it with the × any time; the Next button always brings the full list back.
Once you’re set up, the same list shows what needs attention right now, like payments due this week or a backup that’s getting old.
“Still planned for this month” now appears only in the last 10 days of a month, when it actually matters, instead of from the 1st.

In the last days of a month, Coming Up could leave out a card or bill due early the next month if you had already paid it for the current month — on September 30, a debt due October 7 could be missing. Everything due in the next 7 days now shows, and marking a bill from that row marks it for the month it’s due.
